title: Deprecated code not properly handled
detail: The `code` attribute in `HTTPException` is now optional, but the previous behavior expected it to be an integer. This can lead to unexpected behavior or crashes when the attribute is not provided.

title: Incorrect handling of deprecated parameters
detail: The method `get_description` incorrectly accepts `environ` and `scope` as optional parameters, even though they are deprecated and should not be used. This can lead to misuse and unexpected behavior. The same applies to line 169.

title: Incorrect argument type
detail: The function `_add_cookies_to_wsgi` now takes `WSGIEnvironment` instead of `Request`. This is a breaking change that was not mentioned in the description. The same applies to lines 988, 1235.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The function `force_type` now accepts `Request` in addition to `WSGIEnvironment`. This change is not reflected in the documentation, which only mentions `WSGIEnvironment`.

title: Default number value is incorrect
detail: The default value for `number` is set to '1' instead of an empty string, which can cause issues when parsing keys that do not have a specific number.

title: Incorrect key lookup
detail: The key lookup using `FUNCTIONAL_KEYS` does not account for the possibility of modifier keys, which are not directly in `FUNCTIONAL_KEYS` but should be detected as such.

title: Redundant modifier check
detail: The check for modifiers is redundant when the key is already in `MODIFIER_FUNCTIONAL_KEYS`, which can lead to incorrect reporting of modifier keys.

title: Incorrect Kitty protocol flag
detail: The Kitty protocol flag is set incorrectly, which may prevent the full functionality of the protocol.

title: Incorrect use of maybeDeferred
detail: The method maybeDeferred is used incorrectly with a coroutine. It expects a callable and does not support union types.

title: Inconsistent use of item_completed
detail: The method item_completed is used inconsistently. In one place it is awaited, in another it is not.

title: Incorrect implementation of stat_file
detail: The implementation of stat_file in the test uses asyncio.sleep instead of awaiting a coroutine, which is incorrect.

title: Incorrect implementation of item_completed
detail: The implementation of item_completed in the test does not correctly handle the results and returns a succeeded deferred with the item.

title: Incorrect Exception Handling
detail: The code is catching PermissionError but should be catching OSError instead. The same applies to lines 508, 572, 581, 584.
